title: Vision Plans Exam Visits — Filing Limit and Coverage Started Retroactively by the Binder
content:
**Enrollment and billing bulletin — Vision Plans exam visits**

Whether an exam visit on a Vision Plans enrollment is paid under the exam benefit is decided in this order. The first case that holds governs.

1. **Late claim.** The claim reached Cascade more than the filing limit after the date of service. The limit is 180 calendar days at a participating location and 365 calendar days out of network. Nothing is paid for the visit, and its lines are denied for timely filing.
2. **Binder received for an applied enrollment.** The enrollment still stands applied. The latest binder payment the funding billing account received was not returned, is for at least the plan unit's monthly premium for its coverage tier, and was received on or before the binder deadline. The latest binder payment is the account's latest payment with payment purpose binder, recorded among the Premium Billing Accounts payments, together with any returned-payment entry that names it. The binder deadline is the coverage effective date plus 30 calendar days, and a payment on the deadline day is in time. In this case a service dated on or after the coverage effective date is paid under the exam benefit, coverage having started retroactively on that date.
3. **Every other case.** The enrollment's own status and dates decide. The visit is paid under the exam benefit only when the enrollment is active or terminated and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and nothing is paid.

**Boundaries in figures**

| Test | In time / met | Not met |
|---|---|---|
| Participating location, received after the date of service | 180th calendar day | 181st calendar day |
| Out of network, received after the date of service | 365th calendar day | 366th calendar day |
| Binder received, counted from the coverage effective date | On or before the 30th calendar day | 31st calendar day or later |
| Binder amount | Equal to or above the plan unit's monthly premium for its tier | Below it |
| Binder payment | No returned-payment entry names it | A returned-payment entry names it |

**Hypothetical illustrations**
- Coverage effective 1 March; the enrollment still stands applied; the account's latest binder payment, unreturned and for the full monthly premium of the unit's tier, arrived on 31 March. An exam dated 10 March is paid under the exam benefit.
- Same facts, but the latest binder payment carries a returned-payment entry. Case 2 does not hold. The enrollment still stands applied, so the visit is denied as not eligible.
- An exam at a participating location received 200 days after its date of service is denied for timely filing whatever the enrollment's status.
